regularVsBound: Regular (tradeable) Kinah comes from Marketplace sales, Conquest expeditions and raid kills — it pays for enhancement, transfers and the Legion Hall.
Bound Kinah comes from Duties and quests — it can only be spent (sinks), never traded or listed.
Both share the same wallet display but only Regular funds player-to-player economy. Plan big purchases around Regular income.

altStrategy: Alts multiply every per-character cap: Ascension Trial 3/wk, Superior stones 5/wk, event shops, Conquest cubes.
Default ~4 character slots, expandable to 8 (reported from the Aug 7 livestream).
Anti-bot design taxes alts: no player-to-player trades, Market requires membership, Daeva Pass bills per character.
Founder rewards were patched to be cross-character/server (Oct 6/7) — claim on whichever alt needs them.
Community efficiency estimate for geared alts: ~70–80% of a main.
